Bru

Bidirectional Remote Uplink

What is Bru?

Bru (bridge in Norwegian) lets you read and send SMSes from your browser (TOOD: or desktop?), via your Android phone. It does this by creating an end-to-end encrypted persistent connection to a companion app running as a background service on your phone.

Features

  • Encrypted. Your data is only readable by you.
  • Fully local. No personal data is stored outside of your devices.
  • Hole punching. Works from behind routers and firewalls. No port forwarding or fiddeling with NAT.
  • More? TODO

How does it work?

Bru leverages Iroh to create a persistent connection between your computer and phone.*

As long as the devices are online, Iroh finds a way to connect them, falling back to using a relay if a direct link is not possible. Your data is in any case still encrypted and not readable by anyone.

*This project is not related to the second Scottish national drink.
